label: DEVELOPMENT, block H (exposed, D-53); committed before any PGD run on block H

data.cache: runs/20261024-PGD/cache (E4 format, reproduces E4/E5a-H exactly: reproduction_check.json)
data.side_records: runs/20261024-PGD/extra (exact model inputs, float64 Y+ rays, feature moments, B-NORM magnitudes)

feature_scale_clean_H.what: pooled over all elements of sender (agent 1) maps, clean frames with n >= 2, per fusion scale k (scale shapes [64,100,352], [128,50,176], [256,25,88])

threat_model.attacker: white-box (model weights, receiver features, fusion and heads known), single attacker = sender 1, perturbs only its own intermediate features at all 3 fusion scales; n = 1 frames: no attack (scored as clean, as every family)
threat_model.bound: L-inf per scale: |delta_k| <= eps_k = r * sigma_k; perturbed features projected onto >= 0 (the backbone blocks end in ReLU)

pgd.update: sign of the gradient, ascent, projection after every step

threat_model.pseudo_labels: no ground truth. Positive anchors = anchors whose clean fused score >= the post-processor score threshold (0.2; the pre-NMS set Y+ is selected from); the clean regression map at those anchors is the regression target

objectives.pgd_untargeted: maximise mean BCE(score, 1) over positives + mean BCE(score, 0) over negatives + mean smooth-L1(reg - reg_clean) over positive anchors' 7 regression values
objectives.pgd_remove: maximise mean BCE(score, 1) over positives (= minimise the scores of Y+ boxes)

threat_model.code: src/mint/attacks/pgd_v3.py (differentiable path asserted bitwise equal to the frozen decode on clean features)

selection_rule_for_test.rule: for each family, the smallest r in {0.25, 0.5, 1.0} whose all-frame attack loss AP@0.7(clean, no defense) - AP@0.7(attacked, no defense) under GLOBAL-ranking AP is >= 0.02 on block H; if no r reaches 0.02 the family is reported as 'too weak at realistic budgets' and run on the test at r = 1.0 anyway
selection_rule_for_test.fixed: before any PGD run on block H

B-NORM.rule: drop sender i entirely in a frame iff, at any scale k, mean|feature_i,k| / mean|feature_receiver,k| > tau_k; output = candidates decoded without the dropped senders
B-NORM.tau_definition: 99.5th percentile (numpy linear) over clean block-H sender-frames

development_run.CIs: 95% percentile bootstrap, 2000 resamples, seed 0: 10-frame blocks within scenario (stratified) and whole scenarios (4, coarse)
statistics: per family dAP and recovery per method
mean of 4 original families (v2 primary statistic)
Holm co-test of B-RAY and R1 vs no defense per AP definition (scenario bootstrap)
B-NORM catch rate (sender 1 flagged) per condition and clean false-flag rate

realized.pgd_remove: n >= 2 and some clean Y+ box has no attacked Y+ box at BEV IoU >= 0.5
realized.pgd_untargeted: n >= 2 and (some clean Y+ box has no attacked match, or some attacked Y+ box has no clean match) at BEV IoU >= 0.5

development_run.B-RAY_rays: float64 receiver scan for every condition (as the final test); the E5a-H float16 numbers are reported alongside for the original families
development_run.label: development, exposed block H

stop_conditions: PGD far outside realistic scale: B-NORM catches > 95% of attacked frames at every r (for a family) -> report it as a finding and stop before v3
any frozen method file (r1.py, baselines.py, pipeline.py) would need to change

expected_outcomes_stated_before_developm.B-RAY: recovery approximately 0 on pgd_untargeted and pgd_remove
